title: How to organize the outdoor storage zone | Patio or Deck
description:
Get the cushions under a lid within a minute of the first drop of rain.

This is the Outdoor Storage Zone in the Patio or Deck. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
The lid closes flat without anyone pressing down, cushions in one layer on top, two labelled totes beneath them, and the floor of the box visible the moment the cushions come out.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Empty the deck box onto the boards, all of it.
Straighten: Cushions load last and come out first, because they are the only thing in this box that has to move in a hurry.
Shine: Scrub the interior and prop the lid open on a dry, breezy day until the corners are genuinely dry rather than
Safety: A deck box lid is heavy and hinged at exactly a child's hand height.
Standardize: Two totes, one written games and one written covers, labelled on the short end you can read once the cushions
Sustain: When the cushions go in at the end of an evening, the lid gets latched, not just lowered.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Cushions only on top, two labelled totes below, lid closing flat with no pressure.
